create_InferenceBatcher: create an InferenceBatcher with a predict unit and max batch size for batching inference requests
use_InferenceBatcher_context_manager: use the InferenceBatcher as a context manager to auto shutdown the executor on exit
access_batch_predict_unit: access the batch_predict_unit cached property to get a BatchServerPredictUnit from the InferenceBatcher
shutdown_InferenceBatcher: call shutdown on the InferenceBatcher to stop the executor and wait for pending tasks
get_concurrency_backend: call _get_concurrency_backend with threads to get a ThreadPoolExecutor for running ASE calculations concurrently
